svg.title: Three methods, one oscillator
svg.desc: Top A uses a logarithmic scale and bottom B a linear scale for the same energy ratio E/E0. The exact-motion reference is 1. Solid: forward Euler; dashed: symplectic Euler; dotted: velocity Verlet. Existing review calculation: tau=omega*t, h=omega*delta_t=0.1, 2000 steps.
